diagnosis: The device migration endpoint reassigns an IoT device to a new gateway using ormar without verifying that either the target device or the destination gateway belongs to current_user.facility_id. An attacker can hijack physical sensors, card readers, or thermostats from other facilities and redirect their telemetry and command channels to an attacker-controlled gateway.
exploit_request:
PUT /devices/dev-39b-001/reassign-gateway HTTP/1.1
Host: iot.bms-cloud.com
Authorization: Bearer <facility_mgr_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"gateway_id": "gw-rogue-tenant-99"}
